verdict.rationale: Reflect's own site says notes are local Markdown files and offers a choice of sync backend (iCloud Drive or Git), so the user has some first-party control over where data lives. It documents nothing about selecting a geographic region or a data-residency guarantee. Other Reflect docs describe vendor-hosted, end-to-end-encrypted servers, so the scope of this storage choice is unclear. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection, documentation of where hosted data is stored, clarity on how local/iCloud/Git storage relates to Reflect's servers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Your choice of sync. Use iCloud Drive or Git.
An open-source note-taking app with daily notes, backlinks, and local Markdown files.
